settings.ai.heading: AI Provider
settings.ai.honestyHint: Honest tradeoffs: cloud AI (OpenAI / Anthropic / Google / DeepSeek) is faster and currently higher-quality, but sends a slice of your CV + the job description to the provider's jurisdiction. Local AI (Ollama on your own machine) is slower and quality varies with the model, but no data leaves your device. The full per-provider matrix — quality, latency, privacy, cost, EU AI Act surface — lives in the repository at docs/grant/15-ai-provider-honesty-matrix.md. The system never silently reroutes to a provider you did not pick.

settings.ai.mode.byok.title: Bring your own key
settings.ai.mode.managed.desc: We provide the AI for you — no key, no setup, all included in your Helpmefindthejob subscription. One click to enable when it opens. Best if you don't already have an AI account and don't want to deal with API keys. Tap to join the waitlist; we'll email you the moment it's live.

settings.backup.heading: Backup & restore
settings.bookmarklet.heading: Save jobs from Indeed, LinkedIn, StepStone & Xing in one click
settings.bookmarklet.howto: After dragging, visit any Indeed, LinkedIn, StepStone, or Xing job page and click the bookmark. The page opens Helpmefindthejob in a new tab and adds the job to your queue.
settings.bookmarklet.lead: When you find a good role on one of those sites today, you probably copy the URL, switch tabs, and paste it somewhere to come back to later. This replaces all that with a single button in your browser's bookmark bar. Drag the button below into the bar once — that's the entire setup. From then on, saving any job is one click: the title, the link, and the source land in your Helpmefindthejob queue automatically.
settings.bookmarklet.step1: Make sure your bookmark bar is showing
settings.bookmarklet.step1.desc: It's the row of saved sites under your browser's address bar. If you don't see it, press ⌘+Shift+B on Mac or Ctrl+Shift+B on Windows / Linux to turn it on.
settings.bookmarklet.step2: Drag this button up onto the bar — once
settings.bookmarklet.step2.desc: Click and hold the button below, drag it up onto the bookmark bar, and let go. It now sits there like any other bookmark — but instead of opening a website, clicking it grabs whichever job page you're on and sends it to your queue.
settings.bookmarklet.step3: Done. From now on: find a job → click your new bookmark
settings.bookmarklet.step3.desc: On any Indeed, LinkedIn, StepStone or Xing job page, click the "Send to Helpmefindthejob" bookmark you just installed. The role lands in your queue with its title, the link back, and a small tag showing which site it came from. You can then score it with AI, draft a cover letter, or apply later — all from one place.

settings.frictionClass.heading: Friction-class classification
settings.frictionClass.lead: A deterministic classifier reads your CV and tags one of 7 friction-class patterns (Aïcha §16d / Yusuf Blue Card / Olga §24 / Mahmoud §4 AsylG / Maria EU citizen / Käthe Wiedereinstieg / Tobias Quereinstieg) when relevant. This routes downstream UX (search affordances, AI prompt context) appropriately. Empty means "no clear match" — handled gracefully.
